analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($546.03) vs SMA5/20/50 ($568.70/$581.76/$594.15) — Below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($606.92/$624.30) — Below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (9.5%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.9→37.1) — Oversold condition persists, confirming downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.7939→-4.2147) — Deterioration continues, maintaining a bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $543.11) — Approaching the lower band, exploring rebound potential.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($540.18) — Support zone based on the lower Bollinger band and 52-week low.
· Swing resistance ($599.66) — Resistance zone based on SMA50/200 and Pivot R1.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — Attempting to make higher lows confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.05x) — Normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Hold off on buying due to persistent oversold RSI and deteriorating MACD; maintain a wait-and-see approach.
